# TEP disturbances IDV(1..20)

Process disturbances `/DVEC/ IDV(1..20)`. TEFUNC forces `IDV(i) > 0` to 1, so they are binary.
They are exposed only as `TEP_NATIVE_FAULT` types of the fault engine (`simulator/faults/types.py`,
`_IDVFault`), which toggle the flag and nothing else (`test_tep_native_fault_only_toggles_idv`).
Severity must be 1.0 and gradual progression is rejected. The "Acts on" column is the modelling choice in
`configs/tep_mapping.yaml`; for IDV 16-20 it is derived from where `teprob.f` consumes the flag.
